status: implementation contract; execution evidence in analytics_fix_notes.md

filters.driverId: optional positive integer; route owner, otherwise order driver

trends.kpis: same five KPI objects; target is current configured target

PUT /reports/goals/{code}.response: same as GET; persisted with immutable history, actor from authentication

GET /reports/route-efficiency: array matching efficiency; one row per route; includes empty routes

formulas.IID: orders with 11 ASCII digit recipient RUC + nonblank recipient/address + valid nonzero lat/lon / all orders *100
formulas.CHR: DELIVERED scheduled orders / scheduled orders (route_id present) *100
formulas.TDE: scheduled orders with nonblank photo OR signature / scheduled orders *100
formulas.ONTIME: DELIVERED with POD verified_at <= promised window end / DELIVERED with POD verified_at and window end *100
formulas.completePOD: photo AND signature AND receiver AND 8 digit DNI AND nonzero valid GPS AND two SHA256 hashes AND captured_at AND received_at; metadata check, no remote object verification
formulas.efficiency: Haversine sum over LAG GPS ordered by ping_time,id within route actual time interval and vehicle; >=2 valid samples; no route start => unavailable. timePerStopMin is operation minutes per terminal stop, NOT service time.

historicalComparison: CSV pretest TDE denominator says executed services; current uses scheduled orders. CHR visited points differs from DELIVERED. IID legacy reference is not a validated RUC. No causal or direct like-for-like comparison is claimed.
